name: Telegram Bot (python-telegram-bot)
description: Python Telegram bot. No token is asked during creation; add TELEGRAM_TOKEN later under Startup & Env.
installScript: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt

files..env:
TELEGRAM_TOKEN=
# Only the panel owner (admin) can read this file.
files.bot.py:
import os

from telegram import Update
from telegram.ext import ApplicationBuilder, CommandHandler, ContextTypes


def load_env(path=".env"):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for line in handle:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip())


load_env()
token = os.environ.get("TELEGRAM_TOKEN")
if not token:
    raise SystemExit("TELEGRAM_TOKEN is not set yet. Add it under Startup & Env, then restart.")


async def start(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    await update.message.reply_text("Hello from TerryPanel!")


async def ping(update: Update, context: ContextTypes.DEFAULT_TYPE):
    await update.message.reply_text("Pong!")


app = ApplicationBuilder().token(token).build()
app.add_handler(CommandHandler("start", start))
app.add_handler(CommandHandler("ping", ping))
print("Telegram bot started")
app.run_polling()
